Team Strength Model

This project (find here on GitHub) uses Python to create a team strength model. The final model is an ensemble of a xG and a Goals model that produces an attacking strength and a defensive strength coefficient for each team and a value for the home effect constant. The model is heavily inspired by the works of Dixon-Coles and incorporates a time decay and a “rho” value which captures the correlation between teams’ goal counts, which essentially just adjusts the probabilities for low-scoring outcomes in football matches which Dixon-Coles showed is something that models such as these often under-report on.
